statements.status_notes: bzip2 contains an off-by-one error in the bzip2recover utility. When processing a specially crafted file, the application performs an out-of-bounds write to a global buffer, resulting in memory corruption and a crash (denial of service).
statements.impact_statement: This off-by-one flaw is specific to the bzip2recover recovery utility, not the core bzip2 compression library. Liquibase Secure's container only ever execs the Liquibase Java CLI at runtime; a review of the container's runtime path found no invocation of bzip2recover, bzip2, bunzip2, or any bzip2 API. libbz2 ships only as an inherited base-image library dependency.
